$comment: Native window effect per skin and OS, owned by @aphrody/tauri-theme. Effect names are the tauri-utils WindowEffect values (camelCase) of the pinned tauri 3.0.0-alpha line; `transparent` tells the Tauri window config whether the webview must be transparent for the effect to show. Window colours are never set here: the web content paints M3 roles from @aphrody/m3-tokens.
